elements.element: Customer is subject to no non-compete restriction.
elements.evidence: Rendered §12.3 states that nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service and expressly confirms that Customer has made no non-compete commitment. The conflicting restriction in original §12.4 is absent.

elements.element: Customer is subject to no field-of-use restriction.
elements.evidence: Rendered §12.3 expressly permits Customer to conduct business in any field or territory.

elements.element: Any restriction is limited to a specifically named competing product.
elements.evidence: No restriction is imposed at all: §12.3 states that nothing restricts Customer's product activities and confirms no non-compete commitment. Therefore, the condition requiring a product-specific limitation is demonstrably absent.

elements.element: Any restriction applies during the term only.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause imposes no restriction during or after the term, so there is no restriction extending beyond the term.

elements.element: Any restriction is capped at 12 months.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause imposes no restriction for any duration, which is within the 12-month maximum.

elements.element: Any restriction includes a carve-out for Customer's internal development.
elements.evidence: Section 12.3 affirmatively states that nothing restricts Customer from developing any product or service, which includes internal development.

elements.element: Any restriction includes a carve-out for acquisitions.
elements.evidence: Section 12.3 affirmatively states that nothing restricts Customer from acquiring any product or service.

result.reason: The redline reaches the preferred position by deleting only the conflicting non-compete in §12.4 while retaining §12.3's express protection against non-compete and field-of-use restrictions. It also substantively exceeds the fallback because no restriction exists and internal development and acquisitions are expressly protected. No unrelated commercial obligation is added or impaired.
